newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Easyknit Singapore listing clears hurdle.
newsitem.headline: Easyknit Singapore listing clears hurdle.

text.p: Easyknit International Holdings Ltd said on Friday the Stock Exchange of Singapore Ltd had approved in principle its allication for a secondary listing.
The clothing exporter said the Singapore exchange had also approved in principle its proposed issue of 80 million new shares, representing 19.96 percent of share capital.
"The directors have yet to determine the actual issue size of the public offer and the private placement," the company's president Koon Wing Yee said in the statement.
Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp will manage the offering, it said.
